svg.text: Only complete held-out or verification comparisons are included. Training records are excluded.
The dashed line is equality; predicted values are frozen surrogate means, not uncertainty bounds.
model_scope: Mean-only interpolation inside declared bounds and actual training convex hull. No
uncertainty bands, live Aspen execution or physical validation.
system_boundary: Inherited HTL fixed-background accounting: feed, heater/reactor electricity,
fixed pump inventory, direct CO2/CH4 and wastewater; excludes separator heat duty and
cooling-service burdens; not a full-plant utility inventory
source_note: Per-record source identities and full numerical precision are retained in the
accompanying CSV. Missing records remain in the original artifact. Declared hashes and
qualification are not independently authenticated by this browser export.
